definitions.gloss: an indefinite quantity in the hundreds, roughly 200–900
definitions.explanation: A round approximation used when the exact number is unknown or unimportant, and the speaker wants to indicate a quantity somewhere in the hundreds. Corresponds to English "a few hundred" or "several hundred." Frequently attaches to counters to describe quantities of people, days, years, items, etc.

examples.japanese: {数百|すうひゃく}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数百|すうひゃく}{年前|ねんまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: This book was written several hundred years ago.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{数百|すうひゃく}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: At the new store's opening, several hundred customers formed a long line.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{数百|すうひゃく}⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}して→展開する：25229_tenkaisuru⟧おり、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進出|しんしゅつ}→進出：14387_shinshutsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This company operates several hundred stores worldwide and expands into new markets every year.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (several; a few) + ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ (hundred). The prefix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ can be attached to any large round number to create a vague estimate, and {数百|すうひゃく} is one of the most common members of this family.

RELATED VAGUE NUMBER EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{数十|すうじゅう}→数十：21400_suujuu⟧: several dozen (roughly 20–90)
- {数百|すうひゃく}: several hundred (roughly 200–900)
- {数千|すうせん}: several thousand
- {数万|すうまん}: several tens of thousands
- {数十万|すうじゅうまん}: several hundreds of thousands
- {数百万|すうひゃくまん}: several millions

These all work the same way: ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ + round number = "several of that unit."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数百|すうひゃく}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: several hundred people
- {数百|すうひゃく}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: several hundred yen
- {数百|すうひゃく}⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧: several hundred years
- {数百|すうひゃく}{年前|ねんまえ}: several hundred years ago
- {数百|すうひゃく}⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧: several hundred times (as many / as much)
- {数百|すうひゃく}⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧: several hundred items
- {数百|すうひゃく}⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧: several hundred stores
- {数百|すうひゃく}⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧: several hundred meters

GRAMMATICAL BEHAVIOR:
{数百|すうひゃく} functions as a numeral, so it attaches directly to counters without a particle — just like any number. It can also stand alone as a noun meaning "several hundred (of them)."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何百|なんびゃく}→何百：28714_nanbyaku⟧: hundreds of — more emotional, used when emphasizing a large amount ("hundreds and hundreds").
- {百以上|ひゃくいじょう}: more than a hundred — a precise lower bound instead of a vague range.
- {百数十|ひゃくすうじゅう}: a hundred and some tens — a fusion pattern meaning "a hundred plus several dozen."

USAGE:
{数百|すうひゃく} is a neutral, factual word. It does not imply "a lot" in an emotional sense the way ⟦{何百|なんびゃく}→何百：28714_nanbyaku⟧ does; it simply means "an unspecified quantity somewhere in the hundreds."
